d:
Donald Trump fires back at Barack Obama after the former president mocked his White House renovations as resembling “Saddam Hussein’s Cheesecake Factory.” Defending the makeover, Trump calls Obama “not smart at all” and labels him a “lousy president,” turning the dispute over the White House’s appearance into another political clash between the two leaders
